in_marathi.name: Shvetank
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे White, Pure, Clean
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shvetank हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Shvetank is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'shvet' (white, pure) and 'ank' (support, strength). It is a name that signifies purity, cleanliness, and intelligence. The name is often given to babies born in the winter season, as it is believed to bring good luck and prosperity.
